_doc: Pair judgments for build/check_link_newcomers.py: a link of this base form to this target was weighed against this newer competitor and stays. surface 'kana' covers only links whose surface is kana; 'any' covers every surface. One line per (base, target, competitor); append, never renumber. Kanji-surface links whose kanji the competitor does not use are cleared by the detector itself and need no line here.

judgments.note: kana どう is the adverb 'how'; 胴 (torso) is written in kanji. all 170 links read in context on 2026-09-29; none is 胴 (five that sat inside reading explanations were unlinked instead).
links are compounds (狂言師, 指圧師, 整体師, 彫り師, 木彫り師): the suffix entry, not the noun 師 (mentor). 7 links read.
